content.title: TICT mixed-media stock hook baseline
content.purpose: Establish the first controlled 15-second mixed-media baseline before replacing only the hook with Runway generation.

storyboard.description: A traveller in an airport visibly struggles with fragmented planning on a phone.
The exact approved TICT trip overview is shown legibly.
The approved logo and mascot support one clear call to action.

observations.review_protocol: One midpoint frame per scene, inspected from the rendered MP4; only literal visible evidence is tagged.

scenes.notes: A seated traveller looks at a phone beside luggage. The location resembles a waiting area but airport identity and planning stress are not literal enough to award those tags.
The exact exported trip overview is recognizable and mostly legible, but the large narration subtitle covers a material part of the screen.
Logo, mascot, and one button are visible. Narration subtitles duplicate the deterministic CTA text and partially cover the mascot area.

concept.hypothesis: Demonstrating the visual frustration of switching between 40 open browser tabs and notes apps will resonate with chaotic planners seeking a single unified tool.
concept.audience_problem: Having travel details split across dozens of browser tabs, confirmation emails, and separate map pins.
concept.hook_setting: A dimly lit desk at night with a laptop screen glowing.
concept.hook_camera: Extreme close-up on stressed eyes reflecting dozens of tiny open browser tabs, panning down to rapid frantically clicking fingers.
concept.hook_voiceover: If your next vacation plan looks like forty open browser tabs and pure panic...

hook_beats.visible_action: Rapid cutting between a glowing laptop screen filled with forty tiny browser tabs and a traveller rubbing their temples in distress.
expected_evidence: laptop screen with excessive open tabs
traveller rubbing temples in visible frustration

hook_beats.visible_action: Traveller slams the laptop lid halfway shut in frustration, staring down at scattered printed hotel confirmations.
Screen transitions smoothly into the clear layout of tict as the traveller takes a deep breath.

concept.product_bridge: Transition directly into screens/Plan_Overview_Screen.png, demonstrating how tict turns bookings, saved places, and next steps into one clear trip plan.
quality_criteria: Visually demonstrates browser tab overload within the first 2 seconds without requiring audio
Uses exact captured screen screens/Plan_Overview_Screen.png without generating fake mobile UI
Uses canonical lowercase tict throughout visible and spoken copy

concept.hypothesis: Highlighting the disconnect between saved map pins and actual day-by-day itinerary flow will attract structured travellers who want clear execution.
concept.audience_problem: Having dozens of saved places on a map but no clear sequence or actionable plan for how to visit them.
concept.hook_setting: A sunny coffee shop table covered with a physical paper map, sticky notes, and a phone.
concept.hook_camera: Top-down bird's-eye view zooming down onto a cluttered table with hands frantically arranging color-coded sticky notes.
concept.hook_voiceover: You saved fifty spots on the map, but how are you actually spending day one?

expected_evidence: top-down view of cluttered map with sticky notes

hook_beats.visible_action: Hands sweep away the physical paper clutter, leaving a single clean smartphone centered on the table alongside tict-mascot-1.png.
expected_evidence: hand sweeping paper notes off table
clean focal point on central smartphone

hook_beats.visible_action: The smartphone screen illuminates with the clear trip timeline in tict.
expected_evidence: smartphone screen showing tict plan overview

No generic or generated UI presented as tict
Maintains valid json structure and correct kebab-case concept_id

response.observed_hook_summary: A person looks intensely stressed while illuminated by a glowing laptop screen, frantically typing, closing the laptop lid in frustration, and slumping down over scattered paper notes on a desk.
response.observed_bridge_summary: At 5000 ms, the scene transitions directly from the stressed traveler slumping over desk papers to a full-screen mobile app interface showing an organized trip plan titled 'Your whole trip. One plan.'

evidence.observation: Close-up of a visibly stressed person facing a laptop glow, accompanied by onscreen text reading 'If your next vacation plan looks like forty open browser tabs and pure panic...'.
Person closes the laptop lid and slumps onto scattered paper sheets on the desk in frustration.

hypothesis_match.reason: The hook visually and textually portrays the overwhelm and frustration of chaotic travel planning using scattered notes and computer stress, matching the intended problem and hypothesis.

evidence.observation: Subject displays anxious, wide-eyed distress while staring into the laptop light.
Subject abruptly shuts laptop lid and buries head on hands over desk clutter, visually conveying an overwhelmed emotional state.

target_emotion_strength.reason: The subject's facial expressions and physical actions strongly and clearly depict the target emotion of overwhelm throughout the hook.

evidence.observation: Subject looks distressed while lit by laptop light.
Hands are shown typing on a laptop keyboard above papers, but the laptop screen displaying browser tab overload is not visible on camera.

first_two_seconds_hook_clarity.reason: The initial two seconds show visual computer stress, but without showing the actual browser tabs on screen, the specific problem relies partly on text and narration.

evidence.observation: Subject finishes slumping head onto desk in defeat over paper clutter.
Direct transition into the tict app UI displaying the single consolidated trip overview.

hook_to_product_bridge_coherence.reason: The transition logically moves from the peak moment of planning frustration directly into the product demo offering the unified solution.

evidence.observation: Shows tight facial close-up and keyboard shot rather than a laptop screen showing forty browser tabs.
Subject closes laptop lid and puts head down on scattered paper sheets as planned.

storyboard_action_alignment.reason: The physical action of shutting the laptop and slumping over scattered papers aligns with the storyboard, but the specified visual shot of forty browser tabs on the screen is absent.
